coverage.finding: The folio number '285ᵇ' is written at an angle in the top-left corner. The transcription is correct.

The source reads '√d.93(5). Do, Yajurvedin, by Do. ff.1-2, Col. calls it Yajurvedisūtra. … n.d :2:9:D'. The readings 'Col.' and 'by' stay uncertain. The ditto antecedent is not secure; see the change to relationships.
The line, the dates 'S.1891, Śaka 1756.' and the formula '1834:2:11:D' match the image. The pencil underline under the title is confirmed.
The line matches the image. The word after 'prob.' still looks like 'cata.' but could be 'extr.', so it is left unresolved. The query mark could be '(?)' or '(!)'.
Both lines are represented. In the second line, the shelfmark '(3ᵃ' has an overwritten character and is followed by a closing parenthesis that ends the '(7 bis …' parenthesis.
The interlinear 'ff.1-3 miss[?]' sits above the comma before 'continuation', with an insertion stroke below it. It is correctly attached to r005, and the reading stays uncertain.
The formula 'n.d. : 24 : 8/9? : Beng.' is in lighter ink at the lower right. The figure after '8/' is ambiguous between '9?' and '97'.
Four left-pointing arrows at about y 730, 1285, 2400 and 2840 are recorded in the annotations of each record. The arrow beside b004 has an extra stroke.
From about y 3200 to the bottom edge the page holds only mirror show-through and isolated ink dots, checked in the native bottom tiles. There is no bottom note and no faint addition.
Beyond x≈3230 the image shows fragments of the fol. 286 left margin: '√d', 'd', 'e', 'ff.', 'Own…' and right-pointing arrows. These belong to the facing page and were correctly not transcribed.
